review.notes: All 21 physical pages scanned with a 5-gram PDF-text-to-OCR word-coverage pass. The large p.3 diff is the Figure 1/2 conversation-bubble figure text (figure-internal, left out of the OCR except one leaked bubble which is removed). Footnote bodies for all four superscript-bearing pages (2, 9, 11, 19) were dropped by OCR while markers survived; all bodies were transcribed from 300-400 dpi renders and restored next to their anchors. Table 1/7 HTML tables, heading hierarchy and references were compared against the print with no other drops found. No code fences exist.

patches.before: Figure 1: Performance comparison of GPT-4o Audio $^{1}$ , Kimi-Audio $^{2}$ , Qwen-Omni $^{3}$ and Step-Audio 2 and on various benchmarks.
patches.after:
Figure 1: Performance comparison of GPT-4o Audio $^{1}$ , Kimi-Audio $^{2}$ , Qwen-Omni $^{3}$ and Step-Audio 2 and on various benchmarks.

$^{1}$ GPT-4o Audio is evaluated with gpt-4o-transcribe for ASR and gpt-4o-audio-preview-2025-06-03 for others via official API. $^{2}$ Kimi-Audio is excluded from translation evaluations since it consistently ignores prompts. $^{3}$ Qwen-Omni is evaluated with Qwen2.5-Omni for MMAU and speech-to-text translation, and qwen-omni-turbo-2025-03-26 for others via official API.
patches.evidence: Physical p.2 prints three footnote bodies under Figure 1 (verified on a 300 dpi render): GPT-4o Audio model IDs, Kimi-Audio exclusion from translation evaluations, and Qwen-Omni qwen-omni-turbo-2025-03-26 mapping. The OCR kept the $^{1,2,3}$ markers but dropped all three bodies.

patches.before: Qwen-Omni and Step-Audio 2, on character (for Chinese, Cantonese and Japanese) and word (for Arabian and English) error rates among multiple ASR test sets. N/A indicates that the language is not supported.
patches.after:
Qwen-Omni and Step-Audio 2, on character (for Chinese, Cantonese and Japanese) and word (for Arabian and English) error rates among multiple ASR test sets. N/A indicates that the language is not supported.

$^{1}$ Doubao LLM ASR refers to https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6561/1354868 $^{2}$ GPT-4o Transcribe is evaluated using its latest model, gpt-4o-transcribe, via its official API. $^{3}$ We evaluate without specifying language to ensure a fair comparison. Notably, Qwen-Omni lacks a language-independent testing approach, specifying language may yield better results.
patches.evidence: Physical p.9 prints three footnote bodies under Table 1 (verified at 300-400 dpi): the Doubao volcengine.com/docs/6561/1354868 URL, the gpt-4o-transcribe API note, and the language-independent-testing note. The OCR kept the markers in the caption and body text but dropped all three bodies. The anchor tail is unique to Table 1 (Table 7's caption names Step-Audio 2 mini).
